meta.name: eol-process
meta.description: Run a product sunset end to end — decide, align, plan, prepare, announce, close. Use when you need the whole EOL process, not just one artifact.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从决策到收尾,跑通产品退市全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你正负责产品停止服务的完整流程
copy.tagline_en: Run a full product end-of-life process from decision to closure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're managing the complete process of retiring a product

howto.what: 装上后,它会引导你按“判断—对齐—计划—准备—通知—复盘”的顺序完成产品退役,并随时指出漏掉的步骤,按风险调整流程繁简。
howto.when: 当你明确提出要完整处理一个产品退役(而不是只要一份单一文件等),或者在已开展退役半路出问题、想检查漏了哪一步时。

say.text: 我们要把旧的报表模块退役,决策已做,其余没动。带我走完整流程。
say.note: 它会从第一阶段开始按顺序带你走。

say.text: 我们上周刚宣布一款 API 要停用,客服就被问爆了。我们漏掉了什么?
say.note: 它会定位被跳过的阶段并给补救建议。

say.text: 还没决定要不要停某个功能,你陪我理一理判断依据。
say.note: 它会先评估存续与退役两种信号。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude guides you through a full product sunset: decide, align, plan, prepare, announce, and review. It points out missing steps and adjusts the depth to the risk level.
howto.when_en: Use when you request a complete end-of-life process (not just one artifact), or you're mid-sunset and struggling and need to find the skipped phase.

say_en.text: We're retiring the old reporting module; decision made. Walk me through the whole process.
say_en.note: Starts from Phase 1 and goes in order.

say_en.text: We announced an API sunset three weeks ago; support is drowning. What did we skip?
say_en.note: Diagnoses the skipped phase and suggests next steps.

say_en.text: Not sure yet whether to retire a feature. Help me reason through the decision.
